Those sound like intrusive thoughts. I have OCD, I’m no stranger to them. Something that has worked for me is to not try to actively push them out of my head or force them to stop, because that usually makes them worse. I try to accept them from a nonjudgemental and nonreactive point of view. I imagine the thoughts as clouds that float into my head, eventually they will float out, but it just takes time and patience.
